metadata.description: Tested, ready-to-install Claude Code mods: guardrails, status lines, panes, notifications and fun.

plugins.name: bash-guard
plugins.description: A seatbelt for YOLO mode: blocks catastrophic shell commands (rm -rf ~, mkfs, dd to a disk, fork bombs) and asks before risky ones (force-push, reset --hard, DROP TABLE, curl | sh), even with permissions bypassed.

plugins.name: secret-shield
plugins.description: Keeps secrets out of Claude's context: API keys, tokens, private keys and passwords in tool output are replaced with [REDACTED:kind] before the model or the transcript ever sees them.

plugins.name: slopsquat-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude from installing hallucinated or typosquatted packages: every npm, pip, uv, poetry, cargo and gem install is checked against its registry first. Packages that don't exist are blocked; brand-new, barely used or lookalike packages ask you first.

plugins.name: cost-meter
plugins.description: Always know what a session costs: live $ / context / rate-limit status line, the cost of every turn, context warnings, and an optional budget that asks before spending more.

plugins.name: tool-radar
plugins.description: Mission control for what Claude is doing: a live pane of every tool call with status, arguments, duration and failures, plus /radar summary.

plugins.name: files-touched
plugins.description: Every file Claude changed this session, at a glance: a one-line band above the prompt, /touched for a +/- table, and a pane that drops @file references into your prompt.

plugins.name: git-pulse
plugins.description: Git status at a glance: branch, ahead/behind and changes on the status line, kept fresh as Claude edits, with a heads-up when the branch changes or a turn makes commits.

plugins.name: aim
plugins.description: Pin one goal for the session: it sits above the prompt with a timer, and Claude is told to stay on it and flag unrelated work instead of drifting.

plugins.name: snippets
plugins.description: Reusable prompts one command away: /snip review drops your saved review prompt into the prompt box, with {{selection}}, {{branch}}, {{date}} and {{args}} filled in.

plugins.name: standup
plugins.description: Your standup, written for you: journals every Claude turn (prompt, files, commits) and turns yesterday and today into Yesterday / Today / Blockers with /standup.

plugins.name: tldr
plugins.description: A one-line TL;DR under every long answer, written by a small fast model, so you can skim a wall of text in two seconds.

plugins.name: done-ding
plugins.description: Go make coffee: a desktop notification and a chime when a long Claude turn finishes, and when Claude is waiting on you.

plugins.name: buddy
plugins.description: A tiny ASCII pet that lives above your prompt, reacts to everything Claude does, and levels up as you ship.

plugins.name: wrapped
plugins.description: Spotify Wrapped for your Claude Code life: prompts, tool calls, lines written, streaks, your coding persona, and a share card you can copy.
